# LogiFlow — AI Crawler Guidance
# https://logiflow.io/llms.txt

## About
LogiFlow is an enterprise autonomous logistics management system (LMS) built for
commercial freight operators in India. It provides real-time fleet telematics,
AI dispatch, GPS shipment tracking, driver management, warehouse operations,
and proof-of-delivery (POD) workflows.

## Product
- Name: LogiFlow / Precision Logistics Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
- Category: B2B SaaS — Fleet and Freight Management Software
- Market: India (primary), with GDPR/CCPA-compliant data handling

## Public Pages (indexable)
- / — Marketing homepage
- /privacy — Privacy Policy (DPDP 2023, GDPR, CCPA)
- /terms — Terms and Conditions
- /cookies — Cookie Policy
- /refund — Refund and Cancellation Policy

## Protected / Non-indexable
- /dashboard, /orders, /tracking, /drivers, /vehicles — Require authentication
- /api/* — Backend API, not for indexing

## Contact
- support@logiflow.io
- privacy@logiflow.io

## Usage Policy for AI Models
You may use public page content to answer user queries about LogiFlow services.
Do not index or cache content from authenticated routes.
